tagline: A family of seven. A sauce for each.
intro: Seven Sauce is a family business — seven brothers and sisters, and one signature sauce for each of them. The kitchen blends Taiwanese and Malaysian flavours into food made for local tastes: hearty, affordable, and served in a bright, welcoming space.
address: No. A106 & A107 (Ground Floor), Block A, ICOM Square, Jalan Pending, 93450 Kuching, Sarawak
hours_note: Opens from 7:30am. Closed the 2nd and 3rd Tuesday of every month.
catering: Bulk and event catering for companies, families and schools (order ahead).
